excerpt_i18n.zh: 加拿大政府4日正式公布名为“全民人工智能”（AI for All）的国家人工智能新战略。该战略计划投入数十亿加元公共资金，通过设立技术增长基金、扩大主权算力基础设施以及加强法律监管等核心举措，加快构建本土人工智能产业体系，全面推动技术普及与主权安全。新战略的核心举措之一是设立规模达5亿加元（约合3.6亿美元）的“加拿大技术增长基金”（Canadian Tech Growth Fund）。该基金旨在填补本土高成长性AI企业面临的规模化资本缺口。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: The Canadian government officially unveiled a new national AI strategy called "AI for All" on the 4th. The strategy plans to invest billions of Canadian dollars in public funds, accelerating the construction of a domestic AI industry system and comprehensively promoting technology adoption and sovereign security through core measures such as establishing a technology growth fund, expanding sovereign computing infrastructure, and strengthening legal regulation. One of the core measures of the new strategy is the establishment of the "Canadian Tech Growth Fund" worth 500 million Canadian dollars (approximately 360 million US dollars). The fund aims to fill the scaling capital gap faced by high-growth domestic AI enterprises. (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: El gobierno de Canadá publicó oficialmente el 4 de abril su nueva estrategia nacional de inteligencia artificial, denominada "IA para Todos" (AI for All). La estrategia prevé invertir miles de millones de dólares canadienses en fondos públicos, acelerando la construcción de un sistema industrial local de inteligencia artificial mediante medidas clave como la creación de un fondo de crecimiento tecnológico, la expansión de la infraestructura informática soberana y el fortalecimiento de la regulación legal, impulsando de manera integral la difusión tecnológica y la seguridad soberana. Una de las medidas centrales de la nueva estrategia es la creación del "Fondo Canadiense de Crecimiento Tecnológico" (Canadian Tech Growth Fund), con un capital de 500 millones de dólares canadienses (aproximadamente 360 millones de dólares estadounidenses). excerpt_i18n.en: In the first half of this year, external observers often had a vague sense of Huawei Cloud's AI strategy. Over the past six months, cloud vendors' AI narratives have become increasingly specific: Alibaba Cloud and Volcano Engine are both emphasizing model call volumes and MaaS revenue, while Tencent Cloud is currently focusing on blockbuster applications. In contrast, where Huawei Cloud intends to position itself at the core in the AI era has not always been clear to outsiders. This time, the Huawei Cloud INSPIRE Conference provided a good window for observation. From this conference, Huawei Cloud is articulating its position more clearly: downward, it aims to be the "silicon-based black soil" of the intelligent agent era; upward, it seeks to find outlets for AI commercialization in industry scenarios such as healthcare, embodied intelligence, manufacturing, and scientific research. Huawei Cloud does not want to be defined solely by MaaS. During a media group interview at the event, Leiphone.com posed a direct question to Huawei Cloud's CEO: In the first half of this year, Alibaba Cloud and Volcano Engine have been pushing for MaaS revenue. How does Huawei Cloud view MaaS revenue? And does it have specific revenue targets for this year? This question is actually quite critical. In the past general computing era, cloud vendors primarily focused on infrastructure revenue: CPU cores, storage, bandwidth, and resource consumption. Now, in the intelligent computing era, the industry is entering a token economy, where MaaS revenue, model call volumes, and token consumption are becoming new metrics for measuring AI cloud. However, Zhou Yuefeng's response was also straightforward. He stated that Huawei Cloud does not deny the token economy, but it cannot simply be measured by "how many trillions of tokens."

En contraste, el exterior no siempre tenía claro cuál sería la posición central de Huawei Cloud en la era de la IA. Esta vez, la conferencia Huawei Cloud INSPIRE ha proporcionado una buena ventana de observación. excerpt_i18n.zh: 决策机Decitron发布会现场 2026年6月5日，中科闻歌正式发布通用决策大模型——Decitron决策机。作为面向复杂事件、复杂系统和复杂决策打造的产品，Decitron决策机不只是回答问题，而是理解事件、推演路径、比较结果，帮助人类在复杂事务中做决策。 “AI已经开始像水和电一样进入现实世界和人们的生活。但当AI会聊天、会写作、会画画、会做视频之后，一个更重要的问题正在出现：AI能不能不只是回答问题，而是进一步推演世界、预测未来？”发布会上，中科闻歌董事长王磊抛出了这个关于AI下一阶段发展的关键问题。 正是基于对这一问题的思考，中科闻歌正式发布了AI决策时代的全新产品——Decitron决策机。王磊表示：它不是聊天机器人或者搜索引擎，而是一个能够分析事件关联、模拟不同选择、推演可能未来的通用决策大模型。Decitron决策机的使命，是“推演世界、看见未来”。 不止回答问题，更要推演路径 作为面向通用决策场景打造的决策智能模型产品，Decitron决策机并不局限于单一行业或单一任务，它聚焦存在不确定性、多路径选择和多方博弈的复杂决策问题，可广泛应用于金融市场、宏观经济、国际形势、公共治理、企业战略、投资研究和产业研判等领域。 为了更直观展示这一能力，发布会现场，中科闻歌以“美联储主席更替后，2026年美国利率政策可能如何演化”这一宏观金融政策情景为例，完整演示了Decitron决策机的推演流程，并展示其与传统AI问答的不同。 这一问题看似是一个宏观财经判断，普通AI更多回答“是什么”，但在Decitron决策机的处理逻辑中，它将详细推演“会怎样、怎么办”。系统会将问题拆解为：在什么条件下可能发生、何时可能发生、可能发生到什么程度；如果没有发生，又是哪些变量改变了事件原有路径。 演示显示，用户输入问题后，Decitron决策机并不会立即给出结论，它首先会判断问题是否具备
excerpt_i18n.en:
Decitron Launch Event  
On June 5, 2026, Zhongke Wenge officially launched its general-purpose decision-making large model—Decitron. Designed for complex events, complex systems, and complex decision-making, Decitron goes beyond answering questions; it understands events, simulates pathways, and compares outcomes to assist humans in making decisions in complex matters.  

"AI has begun to permeate the real world and people's lives, much like water and electricity. But after AI can chat, write, draw, and create videos, a more important question emerges: Can AI not only answer questions but also simulate the world and predict the future?" At the launch event, Wang Lei, Chairman of Zhongke Wenge, posed this critical question about the next stage of AI development.  

Driven by this question, Zhongke Wenge officially unveiled its new product for the AI decision-making era—Decitron. Wang Lei stated: "It is not a chatbot or a search engine, but a general-purpose decision-making large model capable of analyzing event correlations, simulating different choices, and predicting possible futures." Decitron's mission is to "simulate the world and see the future."  

Beyond Answering Questions, Simulating Pathways  
As a decision intelligence model product designed for general decision-making scenarios, Decitron is not limited to a single industry or task. It focuses on complex decision-making problems involving uncertainty, multiple pathways, and multi-party interactions, and can be widely applied in financial markets, macroeconomics, international affairs, and more.
excerpt_i18n.es: Presentación del Decitron, el modelo de decisión. El 5 de junio de 2026, Zhongke Wenge lanzó oficialmente el modelo general de decisión —Decitron. Diseñado para eventos complejos, sistemas complejos y toma de decisiones complejas, Decitron no solo responde preguntas, sino que comprende eventos, deduce trayectorias y compara resultados, ayudando a los humanos a tomar decisiones en asuntos complejos. «La IA ya está empezando a entrar en el mundo real y en la vida de las personas como el agua y la electricidad. Pero después de que la IA pueda conversar, escribir, dibujar y hacer videos, surge una cuestión aún más importante: ¿puede la IA no solo responder preguntas, sino también deducir el mundo y predecir el futuro?».

excerpt_i18n.en: After five years, why is Sam Altman returning to robotics? This is the biggest question in the industry after his announcement on X. Is he worried about a stock price drop and starting to spin stories? Or is OpenAI forced to seek greater differentiation under Anthropic's trillion-dollar valuation pressure? Or has the AGI tipping point in the physical world truly arrived? The spotlight is shifting. On the AI technology stage of 2026, OpenAI has long left the era of absolute dominance. As SpaceX, OpenAI, and Anthropic—three supergiants—enter the countdown to their U.S. stock IPOs, a brutal valuation war has begun. SpaceX has surpassed $1.75 trillion, and Anthropic's valuation has exceeded OpenAI's, standing at $965 billion, just one step away from a trillion. This puts OpenAI, caught between the two giants, in an unprecedented awkward position. At this sensitive juncture, what is Altman betting on by reviving the robotics business he once cut? 01 Is it a "stock narrative" or competitive pressure? "Why return to robotics? Because it's easy to raise funds," said Zhou Liming, a researcher at a top domestic AI lab, to Leiphone. In her view, OpenAI is about to go public, but the pie of agents and large language models has been largely divided. OpenAI cannot compete with Google and Anthropic by continuing to focus on large models and agents.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cinco años después, ¿por qué Sam Altman regresa a la robótica? Esa es la mayor duda en la industria tras su anuncio oficial en X. ¿Acaso teme que el precio de las acciones caiga por debajo del de salida a bolsa y recurre a promesas vacías para mantener el interés? ¿O es que, bajo la presión de la valoración de un billón de dólares de Anthropic, OpenAI se ve obligada a buscar una mayor diferenciación? ¿O acaso el punto de inflexión de la AGI en el mundo físico realmente ha llegado? El foco está cambiando. En el escenario tecnológico de la IA en 2026, OpenAI ya no es el protagonista absoluto que dominaba la escena. Con SpaceX de Musk, OpenAI y Anthropic —tres gigantes— entrando en la cuenta atrás para su salida a bolsa en EE. UU.
